responsibility: Host-specific linker-parameter table for GNAT tools such as gnatlink and Mlib. It publishes the canonical defaults for response-file support, object-list option syntax, run-path option syntax, conservative command-length thresholds, shared-vs-static defaults for libgnat and libgcc, object-library extensions, rpath splitting behavior, and libgcc subdirectory naming, letting Ada tools adapt linking strategy to the host linker without hardcoding per-platform policy elsewhere.
